endorsements.name: Julien Szlamowicz
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-8986
endorsements.description: The SOAP API component vulnerability of TIBCO Software Inc.'s TIBCO JasperReports Server, and TIBCO JasperReports Server for ActiveMatrix BPM contains a vulnerability that may allow a malicious authenticated user to copy text files from the host operating system. Affected releases are TIBCO Software Inc.'s TIBCO JasperReports Server: versions up to and including 6.3.4; 6.4.0; 6.4.1; 6.4.2; 6.4.3, TIBCO JasperReports Server for ActiveMatrix BPM: versions up to and including 6.4.3.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.0, 7.7)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
